▸ WYCKOFF · 4-phase cycle · current position MARKUP
QUANTITATIVE · CONFIDENCE 95%
PHASE: MARKUP
The Wyckoff cycle has 4 phases: Accumulation (smart money buys weakness) → Markup (public chases) → Distribution (smart money sells strength) → Markdown (public capitulates). AVGO sits in mid-MARKUP — slope +0.75%/day, up-day volume +9% richer than down-day. Demand exceeds supply on every test.

▸ ELLIOTT WAVE · 5-wave impulse projection
DISCRETIONARY · USE AS CONFLUENCE ONLY
DISCRETIONARY
Elliott Wave is a pattern framework with low quantitative edge in isolation. Two analysts can produce different valid wave counts on the same chart. We surface it for projection + invalidation reference — never as standalone signal. No Wilson LB is computed because there's no deterministic detector.
